title.narrative: Bangladesh’s Advancement for Credible, Inclusive and Transparent Elections (BALLOT): 2025-2027

description.narrative: The project is developed based on the formal request from the Bangladesh Election Commission (BEC), the recommendation of the Needs Assessment Mission conducted by the United Nations in January 2025 and is aligned with the national priorities. The project strengthens institutional, technical and operational capacities of the BEC and right holders to conduct elections that lay the foundation for a more prosperous, inclusive and peaceful Bangladesh. UNESCO's component focuses on Freedom of Expression, Safety of Journalists and Media and Information Literacy.
